summary: Iteration 41 - Pulse Fitness Master Admin Section Testing Complete. All 12 features verified working. Backend: 12/12 tests passed. Frontend: All UI flows verified including Master Admin Pulse section, Organizations account type dropdown, /pulse landing page, and LiteDashboardPage Pro branding/tabs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pulse Fitness Master Admin section is fully functional. The /api/master-admin/pulse-stats endpoint returns correct data structure. Account type dropdown in Organizations table shows 3 options: Full, Pulse, Pulse Pro. The /pulse URL correctly shows PulseLandingPage for non-Pulse users. LiteDashboardPage shows 'Pulse Fitness Pro' branding and 7 tabs for pulse_pro users, and 'Pulse Fitness' branding with 4 tabs for lite users.

1_backend_pulse_stats_endpoint.notes: GET /api/master-admin/pulse-stats returns correct data structure (total_sites, lite_sites, pro_sites, total_users, total_equipment, open_faults, mrr, sites array)

2_backend_account_type_pulse_pro.notes: PUT /api/master-admin/organizations/{org_id}/account-type accepts 'pulse_pro' in addition to 'lite' and 'full'

3_frontend_pulse_sidebar_item.notes: Master Admin sidebar includes 'Pulse Fitness' item with wrench icon

4_frontend_pulse_kpi_cards.notes: Clicking 'Pulse Fitness' loads KPI cards (Total Sites, Pulse Users, Equipment, Open Faults, Pulse MRR)

5_frontend_tier_breakdown.notes: Pulse section shows Tier Breakdown (Lite count, Pro count) and Revenue calculation

6_frontend_pulse_sites_table.notes: Pulse Sites table shows all Pulse orgs with columns: Site, Owner, Users, Equipment, Open Faults, 30d Activity, Files, Tier, Status, Monthly cost, Actions

7_frontend_tier_dropdown.notes: Tier dropdown in Pulse Sites table has options: Lite, Pro, Full (GymFix)

8_frontend_org_account_type_options.notes: Organizations table now shows 3 account type options: Full, Pulse, Pulse Pro

9_frontend_pulse_landing_page.notes: /pulse URL loads PulseLandingPage for admin users (not redirect to /dashboard)

10_frontend_pro_branding.notes: LiteDashboardPage shows 'Pulse Fitness Pro' branding when account_type is 'pulse_pro'

11_frontend_pro_tabs.notes: Pro users see additional tabs (Check Sheets, Reports, AI Diagnosis) on Lite Dashboard - total 7 tabs

12_frontend_lite_tabs.notes: Lite users only see 4 tabs (Dashboard, Equipment, Log a Fault, Documents)
